Lines.en: I almost fell off just now!
User Dave, you were at least 13 meters away from any ledge.
Close enough, it was scary! Can we leave now? Please?
Yes, we're headed for Neon Mixtape Tour.

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots large peas at the enemies
Blocks zombies and produces more sun
Quickly flings stunning butter at zombies
Shoots mighty lasers down the lane
Spreads by shooting spores at zombies
Rolls bouncing, explosive shots that redirect when hitting a zombie
Eats and blocks zombies, producing sun for each zombie eaten
Blocks zombies for long, damages nearby when bitten

Descriptions: Survive with a very fragile ship
